name: Fornecimento
measure: Advisories affecting by severity and the days they stay open; the share of components whose origin is pinned (an integrity, a checksum, a commit, a digest); components without a supplier.
description: The third-party components the repository depends on (DEP), the advisories against them (ADV) and their suppliers (SUP), decided by D-320 (PADRAO-DEV F7).
